# 天聖廣燈錄

**ID:** X1553
**Volume:** X78
**Category:** 史傳部類
**Original Category:** 史傳部／禪宗
**Byline:** 宋 李遵勗編
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 30
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1553

## Contributors
- 李遵勗 (A000520)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The second of the Sòng-era Chán lamp records, in 30 juan, compiled by the lay Chán enthusiast and imperial in-law Lǐ Zūnxù 李遵勗 as a supplement to the *Jǐngdé chuándēng lù* 景德傳燈錄 ([KR6q0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0003)). The title ("Expanded Lamp Record of the *Tiānshèng* era") reflects its Chinese imperial reign-era dating and its deliberate expansion of the *Jǐngdé* genealogy with additional Línjì-line figures and more complete recorded dialogues.

**Abstract**

Lǐ Zūnxù — *fùmǎ dūwèi* 駙馬都尉 (Imperial Son-in-Law), husband of a sister of Sòng [真宗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E5%AE%97) Zhēnzōng's empress — was a substantial lay Chán patron and a serious student of the Línjì line under [谷山石鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%B0%B7%E5%B1%B1%E7%9F%B3%E9%91%91) Gǔshān Shíjiǎn and [孤雲元文](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%A4%E9%9B%B2%E5%85%83%E6%96%87) Gūyún Yuánwén. His compilation presents lamp-record material in the *Jǐngdé* template but with two shifts of emphasis: first, a more detailed treatment of [臨濟義玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%87%A8%E6%BF%9F%E7%BE%A9%E7%8E%84) Línjì Yìxuán and the early Línjì line, effectively promoting the Línjì lineage within the canonical Chán genealogy; second, the inclusion of more ample recorded-dialogue material (*yǔlù* 語錄-style) alongside the biographical-entry format.

The work was presented to Sòng [仁宗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%AE%97) Rénzōng in 1029 (*Tiānshèng* 7, hence the title) and officially printed in 1036. It was incorporated into subsequent canonical collections — the received text is in the Xuzangjing (X78 n. 1553) — and remained one of the five principal Sòng lamp records whose synthesis produced the *Wǔdēng huìyuán* 五燈會元 ([KR6q0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0011)) in 1252.

Lǐ Zūnxù is a rare case of a lay Chán layman producing a work that entered the formal Chán canonical transmission on equal terms with those by monastic compilers, and the *Tiānshèng guǎngdēng lù* is accordingly also important as a document of early eleventh-century lay Chán.
